chains.flow: Agent parses params → ToolPreflight checks permission → Sandbox route (iOS: iSH fakefs; Android: PRoot) → ISHExecutionCoordinator / ShellExecutor → PTY stdin/stdout/stderr → result returned
Agent → Workspace/Sandbox path resolver → FileManager read → contents → Agent context
Agent → Path validation → Workspace/Sandbox isolation → FileManager write → confirmation
Agent → Read current → Apply diff/patch → Write result → Return diff
Agent → BrowserTabPool (iOS: WKWebView; Android: WebView) → Execute action (navigate/click/input/screenshot) → Return result
